brief:
**THESIS STATUS:** WEAKENED

**ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE:** 72%

**OVERNIGHT SUMMARY:** Futures showing mixed action with ES barely positive (+0.02%) while overnight international strength failed to sustain into US premarket. VIX compression from 19.58 to 19.38 provides some support, but momentum has clearly stalled from yesterday's bullish setup.

**KEY DEVELOPMENTS:**
• ES futures flat despite strong Asian session (+1.84% Nikkei, +0.55% Hang Seng)
• VIX declining to 19.38 (-0.56%) suggests fear premium coming out
• Composite scanner signal dropped to 0.048 (NEUTRAL) from bullish territory
• GEX showing positive regime with tight 6800-6830 range, limiting upside momentum
• Polymarket macro sentiment turned bearish (-0.1295) with recession odds at 24.5%

**TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS:** ADJUST

**TRADE NOTES:** Current setup at 6864.5 is only $19.31 above breakeven (6684.19). Consider taking profits on 25-30% of position if ES reaches 6875+ early in session. Tight GEX range suggests limited upside past 6830 call wall. Stop loss at 6840 to preserve capital.

**DAY AHEAD RISKS:**
• Pinned volatility regime with tight GEX range may cap upside momentum
• Macro sentiment deterioration could trigger rotation out of risk assets
• Fed rate cut probability near zero creates hawkish overhang

**DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:**
• VIX compression creating favorable risk/reward for long delta plays
• Any break above 6830 call wall could trigger gamma squeeze higher
• International strength may provide late-session bid if US data supportive
